description: Read a buyer-side tracked-time summary for a project or a contract over a UTC day range (defaults to the current week): total tracked/manual/billable seconds, weighted activity %, and a per-worker breakdown with privacy-masked display names. Pass exactly one of projectId or contractId. Requires time:read scope and exact buyer ownership of the project/contract. This bounded read is available independently of the worker capture rollout; screenshots, window titles, and raw provider payloads are never returned.

contractId.description: Summarize tracked time for one contract (buyer view). Pass this OR projectId.

projectId.description: Summarize tracked time across a project (buyer view). Pass this OR contractId.

name: opentrain_time_summary
